title: Mixed Event — Here on Our Dream Stage — Episode8 The Will to Succeed

meta.Event Outline: The schools of Shibuya are holding the Shibuya City High Schools Joint Festival, a place for students to put on performances. Nene takes on the task of putting on a musical with students from other schools.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: “Hehehe. Hello there, young lady! Aren't you just the cutest?”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: “I'm a musician who loves to dance and sing! Would you like to hear me sing something?”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
“You should also listen to me!
I guarantee you won't be disappointed!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “You two are completely different in terms of styles, but both your performances were so powerful. I was really moved!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I didn't realize music could be so free and fun...!”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “I'd like to sing that song I taught you the other day.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Really well!
You're all reciting your lines much more naturally now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yes!
That means the four of us practicing together was the right call!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
You're all doing an amazing job already.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I feel like you would sound even better if you could really stay in character as you sing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Stay in character as we sing?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes. This is a musical, which means a song's lyrics are also your lines.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, try to sing with that in mind, channeling your characters' emotions into each word.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Channel our characters' emotions into each word...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I never really thought of these lyrics as lines until just now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me neither. I think we were all focusing really hard on singing well, but in a musical, singing itself is part of acting.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, let's take a quick break.
Then we'll do that part again, incorporating the advice Kusanagi just gave us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hi, everyone!
We brought you all some treats!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Minori and Haruka said they'd be taking over some refreshments, so I decided to stop in too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I also wanted to take a photo for the show's pamphlet.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that's right... You're helping the production team with their photography work.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Anyway, we brought you all some drinks!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wow, thanks!
These are just what we need right now. It got really warm while we were singing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We also figured that you'd be hungry, so we brought some food to help you recharge.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
Mini rice balls and... Oh, pickles too?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, because they're a good source of electrolytes. Here, try some.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I will.
Oh, these pickles are delicious...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You're right...
And you can pop these mini rice balls right into your mouth.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you all for bringing these.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...!
Airi, come with us for a second!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You have a few fans besides us who want to show you their support.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hehe. We heard that you were rehearsing for a musical, so we decided to come cheer you on!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We know acting's really tough, but it's great how you're trying something new! So, break a leg!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Unfortunately, you just missed us practicing. We're taking a break right now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why don't you guys stick around and watch us practice for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course.
If anything, I'd like you guys to point out anything that catches your attention.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Okay. Then, we'll watch for a little bit.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We promise to do our best to help you, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But this is the scene where Lulu channels everyone she's met and all her new emotions into song...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to dig deeper. I can still sound better...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's so late, but you're still practicing. I really admire your work ethic!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But the show's tomorrow, no?
Don't push yourself too hard.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I know...
But I want to do everything I can.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Because I absolutely want things to go well tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think our show's really going to be something special. Everyone's put so much effort into it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tsukasa and the others helped me come up with a script and the right effects...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Aoyagi and his team did an great job of capturing each character's emotions in their respective songs...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hinomori and the band decided to put on the best performance they can by not cutting any corners.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Shinonome and the others asked me what kind of set I'd envisioned, and blew me away by coming up with something even better.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What I just said also applies to the other teams. They've all done their absolute best for this show.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They've all helped make this show a reality...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Including the other cast members too, of course.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It can't have been easy, since a lot of them are doing a musical for the first time, but they practiced and persevered...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seeing them work so hard made me want to also do better.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Before I knew it, I was having fun and cherishing every minute of this experience. I've really loved working with them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's why I want to give the audience tomorrow the best show possible.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I want to do everything I can to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A-Anyway, promise you'll all come see us tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We're very much looking forward to seeing it!
